rows.text: returns without work when bits `0x3FFFC` of dword `[rcx]` are all clear; otherwise, for each index below (dword `[rcx]` >> 2) AND 0xFFFF (re-read each pass), clears bit `0x1` of dword `+8` of the qword at index*8 in the array at qword `rcx+0x10`; `rdx` and `r8` are not read
returns 0 when qword `02CA9790` is 0; otherwise returns 1 when qword `02CA97A0` is non-zero and 0 when it is 0

notes: 00243580: the host calls it with three arguments (rdx, 0, byte rcx+0x180) but the body reads only rcx (its rcx is the host's rdx).
